newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA's Calvet to retire, Folz joins board.
newsitem.headline: PSA's Calvet to retire, Folz joins board.

text.p: PSA Peugeot Citroen chairman Jacques Calvet said on Thursday he would retire within a year.
He said Jean-Martin Folz, managing director of the group's car operations, had been appointed to the management board.
Calvet declined to comment on the succession, but Folz's appointment reinforces expectations that he is line.

Calvet said neither he nor the supervisory board had proposed any change to the company statutes, which require the chairman to retire within a year of his 65th birthday. Calvet turned 65 last September.
"I don't know who will present the results next year. What is certain is that I won't present the results," he told a news conference on the 1996 results, which were down sharply.
Folz, formerly managing director at food giant Eridania Beghin-Say, came to the PSA group in January 1996. His appointment to the management board takes effect on May 15.
